ideas.name: Funding Settlement Capture
ideas.claim: Enter the side receiving perpetual futures funding shortly before settlement and close shortly afterward.
ideas.quote: The naive trade takes the receiving side 15 minutes before settlement and closes one minute after, at one-minute prices.
ideas.mechanism: Funding payment and price adjustment around perpetual futures settlement

rules.market: BTC, ETH and ten liquid altcoin perpetual futures
rules.entry: Enter the funding-receiving side 15 minutes before settlement.

ideas.claimed_result: January 2022–September 2026: approximately 1.2 basis points of adverse price movement per basis point of funding; net per round trip was −0.09% to −0.12% for takers and −0.03% to −0.06% for makers.

ideas.name: Funding Before Settlement Hour
ideas.claim: Trade the hour before perpetual futures funding settlement using the last settled funding rate as a directional filter.
ideas.quote: Thresholds were fixed before the first run: above 0.03% or above 0.05% per 8 hours → short; below 0 → long.
ideas.mechanism: Position closing flows before funding settlement

rules.market: Binance USDT-margined BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE, BNB, ADA and LINK perpetual futures
rules.entry: At 07:00, 15:00 or 23:00 UTC, enter short when the last settled funding rate is above 0.03% or 0.05%, or long when it is below zero.
rules.exit: Close at the last hourly close before settlement.
rules.filters: Use the last settled funding rate, eight hours before the settlement being traded.

ideas.claimed_result: For 2020-01-01 to 2026-10-01, the negative-funding long had positive compounded returns on 7 of 8 coins before costs and 3 of 8 with a 0.02% fee per side. The funding-above-0.03% short had positive returns on 3 of 8 before costs and negative returns on all 8 with that fee.
required_data: historical settled funding rates and timestamps
